criteria.duration: Same active backend responds after at least 3600 monotonic seconds
criteria.integrity: Each echo equals the sent tick and active backend PID stays stable
criteria.callbacks: Reverse roots callbacks complete every five active ticks
criteria.metadata: Every connection observes tools/list before its first tool call and contains the required synthetic tools
criteria.realIdle: Idle backend disappears after 900 seconds, within 60 seconds grace; its Python proxy remains
criteria.autoWake: Same SDK connection and Python proxy wake a fresh backend after clean expiry under explicit stateless policy
criteria.churn: Three serial fresh owner connections close with their backend and proxy identities gone
criteria.resources: Complete validated tree with zero unavailable candidates; sampled working set objective 256 MiB; abort above 768 MiB or free physical RAM below 3 GiB
criteria.cleanup: No active proxies in status; direct PID+creation liveness queries find no observed child identity after shutdown, including orphans

scope: Synthetic SDK -> real CLI STDIO; explicit stateless policy, no model calls or production MCP
